title: Green Pumpkin
body:
"It's green. It's a Pumpkin"

Description

The Green Pumpkin is an item that can be bought at Ghoulish Goods for 1,040 Candy in the Halloween 2023 update.

In the Halloween 2024 event, Green Pumpkins can spawn in patches that spawn on Finlay Island, though at a lower rate than the normal Pumpkin. These pumpkins can vary in size, with bigger pumpkins being rarer than their smaller variants.

Depending on their size, green pumpkins can sell for candy, increasing as they get bigger. This is also the case with Composters, as larger pumpkins can fill them quicker than their smaller variants.
